about: The user's decisions on the recipe plan (P14), read by tools/workstation_plan.py after its rules and the bench designs. A key is a recipe id, or family:<name> for every recipe of a family; a value may set fate (go, stay, change, decide), bench, place and note. The showcase Recipes page saves this file from its review list (Save decisions).
